name: @ironflowsh/mcp

tools.name: describe_data
tools.description: Start here for any Hyperliquid question the other tools do not answer directly. Returns the SQL tables you can query with run_query (every fill, per-wallet daily totals, wallet behaviour labels, funding, mark and oracle prices, open interest, liquidations, builder-code fills, transfers, vault flows), their columns, how far back each goes, query tips, worked examples and your own limits.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run one read-only ClickHouse SELECT over Ironflow's Hyperliquid tables (hl.fills, hl.wallet_daily, hl.wallet_behavior, hl.funding, hl.mark_prices, hl.oracle_prices, hl.open_interest, hl.liquidations, hl.builder_fills, hl.transfers, hl.vault_operations). Call describe_data first for columns and examples. Aggregate in SQL: results are capped (1,000 rows keyless). Keyless: last 24 hours, 5 s per query, 60 query seconds per hour per IP; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives 30 days of history.

sql.description: One ClickHouse SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) over hl.* tables, without a FORMAT clause

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 200, capped by your tier)

tools.name: get_wallet_behavior
tools.description: How Hyperliquid wallets trade, from their last 30 days: labels (market_maker, high_frequency, whale, directional, consistent_winner, big_loser, revenge_sizing, often_liquidated, hip3_trader, spot_trader, prediction_trader) and the numbers behind them (maker share, buy/sell imbalance, fills per day, green-day share, profit factor, liquidations). Look up specific addresses, or list wallets with one label.

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses (up to 50). Omit to list wallets instead.

min_volume_usd.description: Only wallets with at least this 30-day volume

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Find how a Hyperliquid market is named: perps (native and HIP-3), spot and live HIP-4 outcomes, with symbol, class, issuer, base asset and Hyperliquid coin. Search with q (q=nvda finds xyz:NVDA-PERP and the other NVDA perps). Pages of up to 100 rows; pass pagination.next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

q.description: Case-insensitive search over symbol, base asset, Hyperliquid coin and issuer

market_class.description: Only this class. 'prediction' is HIP-4 outcomes. Omit for all.

issuer.description: HIP-3 issuer code (e.g. 'xyz'). '' returns native markets only. Omit for every issuer.

include_inactive.description: Also return closed markets (delisted, settled HIP-4 outcomes), which carry active_to_ms. Default false.

cursor.description: pagination.next_cursor from the previous page, with the same filters

instructions: Read-only Hyperliquid market data from Ironflow's own nodes: trades, candles, funding, open interest, liquidations, mark prices, market snapshots and wallet analytics for native perps, HIP-3 builder markets, HIP-4 outcomes and spot. Markets take display symbols (BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC) or Hyperliquid names (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA); list_markets with q finds a name. Times take Unix ms, Unix seconds or ISO 8601. A result that starts with a notice says how a market name was read or that the data starts later than asked; pass its next step on to the user. For anything the named tools do not cover, call describe_data and then run_query with ClickHouse SQL over the hl.* tables. Keyless use allows 10 requests per minute, 500 per day and 24 hours of history; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key raises that to 60 per minute and 30 days.
